timecoded_text_to_speech.text: X's Blake Shelton and Miranda Lambert both attended the 2019 ACM awards with their significant
others. Miranda took a possible public gig at Blake when singing a medley of her hit songs.
The most treble Macentire later made a suspicious comment and Blake's favorite had everyone
talking. Don't mess with Oklahoma. The 2019 ACM awards were full of polarizing performances,
amazing outfits, and hilarious jokes from 16-time host treble Macentire. But the biggest
names in country music also threw some major shade, and the crowd was loving it.
First, Miranda Lambert belted out her hit Little Red Wagon, and didn't hold back when she sang lyrics
that said she, got the hell out of Oklahoma. Many took it as not so subtle to get her ex-husband
and Oklahoma native, Blake Shelton, who was sitting in the audience with his current girlfriend
Gwen Stefani. The awkward encounter would have probably been forgotten, but then fellow
Oki Riba decided to speak out in favor of her home state. When introducing Blake later
in the evening, Riba said the following.
�I love this next performer for many reasons, he�s charming, funny, handsome, talented,
sings like an angel, and always writes his own introductions, give it up for my fellow
Oklahoma and friend, Blake Shelton. Riba likely didn't realize she was jumping in on
the drama, but fans watching at home immediately started speculating that she was giving the
sass back to Miranda. One person summed it up perfectly with, �I just love her for
that low-key shade.� Of course, Riba wasn't just standing up for Blake, but for Oklahoma
and everywhere. After all, Carrie Underwood, Garth Brooks, and Vince Gill all hail from
the southern state. And regardless of if Riba was serving up a little jam, or just calling
out a commonality she shares with the voice coach, we think we can all agree that Oklahoma
fans have each other�s backs.
